verdict.rationale: Unity documents command-line/headless builds (`-batchmode`, `-nographics`) via Editor and Player command-line arguments, plus a dedicated CLI explicitly designed for CI pipelines and build agents without needing the Hub UI, and a separate Build Automation product for multiplatform CI builds — squarely matching the story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party confirmation of a full headless CI build pipeline working end-to-end (one community comment even describes licensing costs blocking a CI build server setup, though this is a cost/licensing caveat rather than a technical failure of the headless build capability itself).
